name: The Grizzled Den
summary: In Dun Morogh, Pilot Stonegear tests a recruit's grit in the Grizzled Den. From Steelgrill's Depot near Kharanos, he sends them west to hunt wendigos for thick pelts to warm his siege engine, Trollplow.

sections.title: A Test of Grit
sections.body: Pilot Stonegear, stationed at Steelgrill's Depot near Kharanos, claims to have the nerves and constitution needed to operate a massive dwarven siege tank in freezing mountain air. He makes newcomers prove they share his grit. The test sends them into the frozen hills to face the native beasts.

sections.title: Creature Comforts in Trollplow
sections.body: Pilot Stonegear's siege engine bears the name Trollplow, and its iron-plated cabin is cramped and cold in Dun Morogh's bitter climate. He seeks a practical remedy in wendigo pelt. Thick manes from the ferocious wendigos of the Grizzled Den can make a warm, durable rug for Trollplow's deck, while helping keep the local beasts in check.

faq.answer: Pilot Stonegear is a dwarven siege engine driver stationed outside Kharanos in Dun Morogh. He pilots Trollplow, an armored war machine, and takes pride in his iron nerves and mechanical trade.

faq.q: Where is the Grizzled Den located?
faq.answer: The Grizzled Den lies in the snow-covered mountains directly west of Kharanos. Its caves are a lair for Dun Morogh's vicious wendigos.

faq.q: Why does Stonegear want wendigo manes?
faq.answer: Stonegear wants wendigo fur to make a warm rug for Trollplow's interior deck. Gathering the pelts also tests an adventurer's bravery.
Trollplow is Pilot Stonegear's personal dwarven siege engine. Its name reflects the conflict between Ironforge dwarves and the hostile Frostmane trolls in the surrounding crags.

faq.q: What kind of creatures inhabit the Grizzled Den?
faq.answer: Savage wendigos inhabit the Grizzled Den. These feral, ape-like beasts are native to Dun Morogh's snowy heights and fiercely defend their territory.

faq.q: Are the wendigos dangerous to Kharanos?
faq.answer: Wendigos rarely organize attacks like the Frostmane trolls, but their violent ferocity and nearness to the main roads put travelers and local tradesfolk at risk.

angles.text: As a young Mountaineer or Ironforge adventurer, facing the wendigos of the Grizzled Den is a local rite of passage.
If you appreciate dwarven siege craft, you know heavy machinery needs clever ways to stay warm in sub-zero weather.
Living beside the dwarves around Kharanos means you can help equip Ironforge's heavy armored engines.
